name: claude-mission-control
description: Terminal multiplexer for Claude Code — real-time visibility into agents, thinking, tools, and file changes

scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts --format esm --target node22 --external node-pty --external @xterm/headless --external chokidar && cp src/hooks/hook-forward.mjs dist/hook-forward.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm test && node --import tsx test/smoke-test.ts && node --import tsx test/e2e-headless.ts
